answer.explanation: From 00:03:17Z the Uploader fails on every PutObject with NoSuchBucket. Its live OUTPUT_BUCKET is 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', while the IaC template sets OUTPUT_BUCKET to !Ref OutputBucket, which resolves to lambda-rca-bench-outputbucket-sglpryesfryi. The function was modified at 00:03:14Z, one second before the window, and no commit in the window explains the change, so it is an out-of-band configuration edit. The error is NoSuchBucket, not AccessDenied, so the IAM role is not the cause. The failures are continuous from 00:03 to 00:13 (about 40 errors per minute, roughly half of the invocations). The Thumbnailer and Compression functions show no such drift. The Oct 22 OUTPUT_BUCKET commits were reverted before the window and do not match the live value.
